added: Manual extension discovery on refresh for APKs installed through the Android package installer.
improved: Refreshing Browse → Extensions now scans Android-installed and in-app extension APKs before updating the online store, including externally installed test APKs.
The Installed and Untrusted sections can update without force-stopping Seiryn after a manual extension install.
fixed: Resolved a refresh-path bug where manually installed or updated extensions were not rescanned when the Android package-change broadcast was missed.
